posts.topic_title: PCGGIII will be in one month
posts.author: JohnFP
posts.post_subject: PCGGIII will be in one month
posts.content_md:
OK, I am taking requests.

Dave B. or Bill P., is there anything I can do, present or contribute to the PCG III that you are specifically interested in?

Does anyone have a green laser they will have there, after I coat, we could sensitize and shoot some green wavelength DCG holograms. 

Jeff, do you mind if I use the new formula if green is available?

John, what do we have in the way of actually making holograms? Is your table set up and ready to shoot? Do you have film? Chems? What do you need?

Dave, have you dabbled in Yea old Red Sensitive DCG? Maybe we could do some red DCG.

I will bring glass, gelatin, magnetic heater/stirrer, overflow bowl, heating pad and spinner all to demonstrate making emulsion. And if a green laser can be had, I will bring Dichromate and other chems needed to make the plates green sensitive, cover glass, epoxy, blow dryer, fixer and/or heater oven and alcohols.

I may demonstrate my technique of cleaning glass as it seems some have problems with it sticking and I never do.

Also, maybe we could do a proximity image planed reflection from a red reflection H1 if we have red film and chems and someone has a red reflection hologram. If not and we get a green laser, then we could do it in green in DCG. I am sure I have something that will reflect 532. Unfortunately the only film I have other then DCG is 2x2 green silver.

Finally, if we do shoot a Denisyuk, I would not mind trying the dual reference beam for a test. This would be good with knowledgeable silver halide holographers. I could bring the gray object and the large flat surface mirror.

Input??? Comments???

posts.content_md:
I am trying to get a handle on who will be at the next meeting and so I e-mailed Danny. He wrote back:

I was looking so forward to attending pcg 3 .....I will have to decline this time...my wife just had a iodine/radium treatment to kill overactive thyroid ..... the treatment when very well.... but there is still a 6 moth period to watch her...as they balance her thyroid.

I feel...even thro I have a strong love for holography that I need to be there for her ....maybe by pcg 4 ...minds will have change...and if so will lookfoward to attending then....thanks for thinking of me holo friends

yours truly Danny

So it looks like Danny is off the list.
